verdict.rationale: Mesh documents a broad public REST API. It uses API credentials generated in the web app with configurable permissions and expiry. Reference endpoints cover customers, monitoring configuration, cases, audit trails, exports, roles and transaction processing, with sync/async and batch screening, case remediation via API, rate-limit headers, versioning, and a downloadable Postman collection and OpenAPI schema. A probe parsed a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covering these resources. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of actually driving the product via authenticated API calls (the probe only retrieved documentation).
